contexts.text: They shall eat their bread in solicitude (). AE 304:7.
Hence (the Angels) have no solicitude about future things.
In the life of the body there inflow... solicitudes about future things; (but not there). SE 2188.
Delighted with the Word, but not solicitous about the understanding of it.
(Here) the seed... is in the midst of jungles and thickets, which are... cares and solicitudes... but when these are put off (there) the seed grows.
He who believes that he rules himself... is borne into solicitudes about future things.
For man is little solicitous about the things of the (future) life... If he were solicitous about (them), he would easily apprehend these things.
Under Future, see this reference. AC 5178. AC 8247.
Others cast themselves continually into solicitudes and cupidities. Explained.
Fear not = not to be solicitous.
This state is devoid of all solicitude about future things. Explained.
No solicitude about future things then renders the man unquiet. Explained.
That they must not be solicitous about the acquiring of it from themselves. Signified, Explained.
Solicitude about future things reigns universally with them.
To be solicitous about the acquiring of good from themselves. Signified, Explained.
For when man is in Heaven, he is devoid of all solicitude... and then has bliss.
(In Saturn) they are little solicitous about food and clothing...
(Those in a state of innocence) are not solicitous about future things: solicitude about future things they call care for the morrow...
Are instructed by the Angels with solicitous care.
They had not been solicitous about Divine truths.
See Future.
Be not solicitous for your life (). Explained.
